hook: Your map shows a Spanish town sitting inside France.
title: The Spanish Town Surrounded By France
description:
Llívia is a Spanish town completely surrounded by France in the Pyrenees. A 1659 treaty gave France villages, but Llívia counted as a town, so Spain kept it. A short road links it to the rest of Spain.

#Shorts #Geography #PlacesThatShouldntExist
